title: Sometimes I Scare Myself: A Collection of Horror
author: Jeneva Rose

facts.text: This is Jeneva Rose's first horror book and first short story collection -- every one of her previous books (One of Us Is Dead, The Perfect Marriage and its sequel) was a thriller.

The collection has three stories: "Never Kill the Medium" (a 30th birthday dinner turns deadly after someone hires a medium for a playful seance), "The Nightmare House" (a family moves into a home with a secret past, and a mother's hauntings get dismissed because of her history with postpartum depression), and "All Curses Are Final" (set in Minnesota).
Rose has said the collection was directly inspired by her own experience -- including the birth of her first child -- and that it's the first time she let the violence "sit fully on the page."
It published September 22, 2026 via Blackstone Publishing and picked up several notable best-of/pick lists right out of the gate, including a Publishers Weekly Pick and a 2026 Shelf Awareness Pick.
